access.notes: Server-rendered forecast values are extracted from normalized visible text. The page grew slightly beyond the global 1 MB fetch cap, so this source alone has a 1.5 MB response limit; no smaller public forecast endpoint was found during the 2026-08-16 review.
The public page exposes a deterministic next-48h reset chance in visible text; whitespace before the percent sign is tolerated because SSR markup may split the token.
The headline Reset probability is paired with the visible next-24h public-signal label.
The public client loads its 48-hour forecast from /api/forecast; raw homepage HTML may remain a loading placeholder.

The documented /api/v1/status endpoint exposes an optional active_watch with reset_chance_percent, forecast_window, observed_at, and expires_at. A null active_watch is a healthy idle state. Variable-window forecasts are archived as issued and are not mapped into V1 fixed-horizon rankings.
